summary: The public title of this exercise is LRU Cache. Read one command per line from standard input and compute the result named by that title, using only those values. Print the result as one result line for each command. The sample below is a short input written for this playground so the printed line can be checked locally. It is not a copy of an example from the problem site. The input stays under one hundred elements so it finishes quickly in the browser.
notes: Compare after trimming trailing newlines. The input is one command per line.
